_note: HELD-OUT evaluation set. Written after the exemplars were tuned and never used to adjust them. text_benchmark.json and the earlier novel probe were both used for tuning, so their scores are optimistic; this file is the unbiased estimate. If you tune anything against these cases, retire the file and write another — a held-out set survives exactly one honest use per change.
